$description: Type, space, shape, elevation, motion, layout (design v6, Fluent 2 values from @fluentui/tokens). One ramp for every platform; sizes in px (web converts to rem).

font.fallback: 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif
font.$note: Fluent 2 uses regular and semibold; bold only for the wordmark-sized display, extrabold for the wordmark

display.$use: Fluent Large Title: landing hero, one per page

title3.$use: Fluent Subtitle 2: card title, dialog title, list group

body.$use: running text on phones, long reading on the web

bodySm.$use: Fluent Body 1: the default text of web pages, dense lists, tables

label.$use: Fluent Body 1 Strong: buttons, tabs, field labels

caption.$use: Fluent Caption 1: timestamps, badges, help text

radius.$note: Fluent: xs (Small) badges and tags; control (Medium) buttons, inputs, chips, tabs, list rows; card (X-Large 8) cards, dialogs, menus, popovers, images; sheet 12 the top of a bottom sheet; full avatars, switches, dots only

elevation.$note: Fluent shadow2/4/8/16/28/64: card = shadow4 (content on the canvas, instead of a border), raised = shadow8 (hover, sticky bars), overlay = shadow16 (menus, popovers, snackbars), sheet = shadow28, dialog = shadow64

motion.$note: Fluent durationFast/Normal/Slow and curveEasyEase / AccelerateMax / DecelerateMax. Off when the user asks for reduced motion.
